proposal.hypothesis: The baseline solve prompt has no verify-and-retry loop, so the agent exits before the bench verifier observes success; instructing iteration until verification passes addresses terminal-bench reward failures.
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Solve-mode prompt now requires post-change verification and iteration until the task checker passes.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
